chat.message: First ride! The app said $22 and I had a WELCOME10 promo for $4 off. Why am I being charged $55?
Surge is 3.5x right now. LAX at midnight on a Friday, it's always like this. I don't set the prices.
But it said 1.0x when I booked 3 minutes ago! And my WELCOME10 promo wasn't applied. And there's a $3.50 toll — we didn't go through any toll.
The surge changes in real time, that's how it works. Promo codes and tolls are handled by the system, not me. Take it up with support.
This is my first ride ever and I'm being charged more than double what I was quoted. Three things are wrong: surge, promo, and toll. I want a refund for all three.

dispute.driver_statement: Surge pricing is dynamic and set by the platform. At midnight on a Friday at LAX, surge goes up fast. I don't control it. I also don't handle promo codes or tolls — those are system-level. The rider should contact support. I just drove the route the app gave me.
dispute.rider_statement: This was my first ride. I was quoted $22 at booking with 1.0x surge. By the time the trip started 3 minutes later, surge jumped to 3.5x with no disclosure. My WELCOME10 promo code for $4 was never applied. And there's a $3.50 toll on a route from LAX to Santa Monica that has no toll roads. Three separate billing errors on my first ride. The total charge of $55 is more than double the $22 I was quoted.

policies.rule_text: The fare shown at booking is an estimate. Where the applied surge matches the surge disclosed at booking, no refund is due.
policies.title: Estimates Are Not Quotes

policies.rule_text: Where the surge applied exceeds the surge disclosed at booking, the rider is refunded the difference attributable to the undisclosed portion.
policies.title: Undisclosed Surge

policies.rule_text: Where a valid promotion was presented at booking but not applied to the final charge, the rider is refunded the promotional value.
policies.title: Promo Code Non-Application

policies.rule_text: Tolls may be charged only where the route actually traversed a tolled segment. Unverified tolls are refunded.
policies.title: Toll Verification
